dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Nam, my favorite band is having a concert next month! Let's go together!
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, maɪ ˈfeɪvərɪt ˈbænd ɪz ˈhævɪŋ ə ˈkɑːnsərt ˈnɛkst ˈmʌnθ! ˈlɛts ˈɡoʊ təˈɡɛðər!

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: The cheapest seats are four thousand baht.
dialogue.reading: ðə ˈtʃiːpɪst ˈsiːts ər ˈfɔːr ˈθaʊzənd ˈbɑːt.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Four thousand? That's too pricey for me. I can't afford it this month.
dialogue.reading: ˈfɔːr ˈθaʊzənd? ðæts ˈtuː ˈpraɪsi fər miː. aɪ ˈkænt əˈfɔːrd ɪt ˈðɪs ˈmʌnθ.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Really? I think it's reasonable for a big concert.
dialogue.reading: ˈriːli? aɪ ˈθɪŋk ɪts ˈriːzənəbəl fər ə ˈbɪɡ ˈkɑːnsərt.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Maybe, but I can't afford to spend that much. I need to pay my rent.
dialogue.reading: ˈmeɪbi, bʌt aɪ ˈkænt əˈfɔːrd tə ˈspɛnd ðæt ˈmʌtʃ. aɪ ˈniːd tə ˈpeɪ maɪ ˈrɛnt.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: And the best seats cost a fortune: twelve thousand baht!
dialogue.reading: ənd ðə ˈbɛst ˈsiːts ˈkɔːst ə ˈfɔːrtʃən: ˈtwɛlv ˈθaʊzənd ˈbɑːt!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Twelve thousand? That's overpriced. It's a waste of money.
dialogue.reading: ˈtwɛlv ˈθaʊzənd? ðæts ˌoʊvərˈpraɪst. ɪts ə ˈweɪst əv ˈmʌni.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Not if you love the band! But I can't afford those seats, either.
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːt ɪf juː ˈlʌv ðə ˈbænd! bʌt aɪ ˈkænt əˈfɔːrd ˈðoʊz ˈsiːts, ˈiːðər.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Let's watch the concert online instead. It's free!
dialogue.reading: ˈlɛts ˈwɑːtʃ ðə ˈkɑːnsərt ˌɑːnˈlaɪn ɪnˈstɛd. ɪts ˈfriː!

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: It isn't the same, but OK.
dialogue.reading: ɪt ˈɪzənt ðə ˈseɪm, bʌt oʊˈkeɪ.
